FLAG STUDY, 2026-10-06
A jump of 20%+ on at least 5x normal volume, then 3+ quiet days on drying volume, then a break above the quiet range. Bought on the break, stop at the bottom of the range, out after 5 sessions.

CONCLUSION: Too few finished flag trades in these 45 sessions to judge. It needs more weeks.

What became of 314 heavy-volume jumps: 273 never formed a flag, 17 formed one and broke down, 9 went nowhere, 2 gapped away with no fair entry, 13 broke out and gave an entry.
All flag trades: average -3.4%, typical -2.1%, 31% ended higher (13 trades)
5 USD and over: average -2.0%, typical -0.7%, 30% ended higher (10 trades)
Under 5 USD: average -8.2%, typical -2.1%, 33% ended higher (3 trades)
Compare, buying the morning after the jump: typical -4.1%, 39% ended higher (871 cases).
